# Result tables (auto-generated by build-report.R)

Times are seconds: median of the repeated calls in a fresh R process (`med_s`), see R/bench.R. Engines: `mssql` = SQL Server (odbc), `oracle` = Oracle (odbc), `roracle` = Oracle (ROracle), `duckdb` = duckdb (in-process). Plain-language write-ups: `docs/`.

### `age + 1` vs `age + 1L`: SQL and the R class you get back

| engine | what | age_class | sql |
|---|---|---|---|
| mssql | age (as stored) | integer | `SELECT * FROM [bm_mix_1e6]` |
| mssql | age + 1L | integer | `SELECT [id], [age] + 1 AS [age], [sex], [prov], [income], [wgt], [ref_date], [flag], [name], [amount] FROM [bm_mix_1e6]` |
| mssql | age + 1 | numeric | `SELECT [id], [age] + 1.0 AS [age], [sex], [prov], [income], [wgt], [ref_date], [flag], [name], [amount] FROM [bm_mix_1e6]` |
| oracle | age (as stored) | numeric | `SELECT * FROM "bm_mix_1e6"` |
| oracle | age + 1L | numeric | `SELECT "id", "age" + 1 AS "age", "sex", "prov", "income", "wgt", "ref_date", "flag", "name", "amount" FROM "bm_mix_1e6"` |
| oracle | age + 1 | numeric | `SELECT "id", "age" + 1.0 AS "age", "sex", "prov", "income", "wgt", "ref_date", "flag", "name", "amount" FROM "bm_mix_1e6"` |
| roracle | age (as stored) | numeric | `SELECT * FROM "bm_mix_1e6"` |
| roracle | age + 1L | numeric | `SELECT "id", "age" + 1 AS "age", "sex", "prov", "income", "wgt", "ref_date", "flag", "name", "amount" FROM "bm_mix_1e6"` |
| roracle | age + 1 | numeric | `SELECT "id", "age" + 1.0 AS "age", "sex", "prov", "income", "wgt", "ref_date", "flag", "name", "amount" FROM "bm_mix_1e6"` |
| duckdb | age (as stored) | integer | `SELECT * FROM bm_mix_1e6` |
| duckdb | age + 1L | integer | `SELECT id, age + 1 AS age, sex, prov, income, wgt, ref_date, flag, "name", amount FROM bm_mix_1e6` |
| duckdb | age + 1 | numeric | `SELECT id, age + 1.0 AS age, sex, prov, income, wgt, ref_date, flag, "name", amount FROM bm_mix_1e6` |
